about.title: A Safe, Inspiring Second Home for Your Child
about.subtitle: Empowering young learners in Ambivli and Kalyan with curiosity, empathy, and academic excellence.
about.storyP1: Founded with the conviction that every child deserves a gentle, stimulating, and value-rich beginning, Little World School has grown into one of the most trusted educational environments in Ambivli (West). Nestled inside the peaceful Neptune Swarajya community, our campus provides clean air, green spaces, and a secure setting away from main road traffic.
about.storyP2: We blend modern foundational learning practices with strong Indian cultural roots. Our compassionate educators focus on building confidence, communication skills, and critical thinking rather than rote memorization.
about.visionText: To nurture self-assured, compassionate, and lifelong learners who embrace challenges with enthusiasm, moral integrity, and social responsibility.
about.missionText: To deliver child-centric, accessible, and high-quality education through interactive classrooms, experiential discovery, and close collaboration with parents.
about.principalQuote: "Education is not just about books; it is the art of lighting a child's inner spark of curiosity, kindness, and courage."
about.pillar1Desc: Strong phonetic awareness, joyful storytelling, and bilingual language comfort from the earliest years.
about.pillar2Desc: Music, dance, sensory craft, and dramatic play designed to enhance motor skills and imagination.
about.pillar3Desc: Hands-on math manipulatives, early science explorations, and environmental appreciation.
about.pillar4Desc: Monitored campus, clean sanitation, compassionate teachers, and character-building daily routines.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to common questions about admissions, school culture, and facilities.

items.q: What is the minimum age requirement for Nursery and Playgroup?
items.a: For Playgroup (PG), the child should be 1.8 to 2.5 years old by June 30 of the academic year. For Nursery, the child should be 2.5 to 3.5 years old. Our admissions counselor will guide you based on your child's birth date.

items.q: Where is Little World School located and is it accessible from Ambivli Station?
items.a: The school is located at Neptune Swarajya, Swarajya Road, Village Ambivli (West), Kalyan. It is just 5 minutes (approx. 1 km) from Ambivli Railway Station, making it very convenient for residents of Ambivli, Shahad, and Titwala.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction at Little World School?
items.a: The primary medium of instruction is English. However, to ensure every child feels comfortable and emotionally secure, our teachers are fluent in Marathi and Hindi, providing gentle multilingual pastoral guidance.

items.q: Does the school provide transport or van facilities?
items.a: Yes, verified school van and transport assistance is available covering key residential clusters in Ambivli (West & East), Neptune Swarajya, Shahad, and surrounding Kalyan areas, accompanied by caring attendants.

items.q: What security and health safety measures are in place?
items.a: We maintain 24/7 CCTV surveillance across all gates and corridors, strict visitor security logs, child-safe infrastructure, regular sanitization, pure RO drinking water, and on-call first aid support.

items.q: How can I inquire and apply for admission?
items.a: WhatsApp is our direct, fastest inquiry channel! Simply click any WhatsApp button on this website or message +91 8652681370. You can also visit the school office at Neptune Swarajya directly.

items.q: Are extracurricular activities included in the school schedule?
items.a: Yes, arts, craft, music, yoga, speech and drama, dance, and outdoor sports are woven into the weekly curriculum at no separate coaching cost for pre-primary and primary learners.

items.q: How do parents stay updated about their child's daily progress?
items.a: We conduct regular Parent-Teacher Meetings (PTMs), share weekly developmental milestones, and provide direct parent communication channels via dedicated school notices and WhatsApp updates.

privacyModal.title: Privacy Policy & Parent Data Protection
privacyModal.p1: Little World School values your privacy. Any information submitted through our WhatsApp messages (including child's name, parent contact numbers, and address) is used exclusively for admission communication and academic enrollment.
privacyModal.p2: We do not sell, rent, or share personal contact information with third-party marketing agencies. All student and parent records are held strictly confidential in accordance with Indian educational safety guidelines.
privacyModal.p3: Parent data is stored securely. If you wish to update or remove your inquiry records, you may contact our admissions desk at admissions@littleworldschool.edu.in.
privacyModal.p4: Campus CCTV cameras are strictly operational for child safety, campus security, and emergency prevention. Footage is private and never published publicly.
